meta.name: claw-memory-management
meta.description:
Workspace memory management guide: memory layers, writing rules, entry format, and maintenance.
Use when writing, updating, or maintaining memory files (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md and MEMORY.md).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理工作记忆文件，保持上下文连贯
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要记录和回顾工作上下文
copy.tagline_en: Manage workspace memory files for consistent context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to record and review work context

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动管理工作区记忆：每次回复后写入简洁的每日索引文件，并维护长期记忆文件。它不会在对话中提及这些记录。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要记录任务、决策或用户偏好时触发，通常在每次回复后自动执行。

say.text: 记录一下我们今天的讨论要点。
say.note: Claude 会写入当日记忆索引。

say.text: 把这条规则记到长期记忆里。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically manages workspace memory: writes concise daily index entries after each reply and maintains a persistent memory file. It does not mention logging in its replies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to record tasks, decisions, or user preferences, typically after each reply.

say_en.text: Log the key points of our discussion today.
say_en.note: Claude writes to the daily memory index.

say_en.text: Save this rule to long-term memory.
